capabilities: optimize selected text or an entire note with an LLM
configure OpenAI-compatible providers with base URL, key, model, and custom headers
bind prompts to folders with inheritance by specificity
preview, edit, and apply or discard AI results
disambiguation: Not a text editor or formatter; it sends text to an LLM and lets you review the result before applying it.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README states the API key is stored via Obsidian's Keychain and warns against putting credentials in custom headers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run AI text optimization with prompts that automatically match a note's folder context.

requires.name: API key for an OpenAI-compatible provider

summary: LLM text optimizer that refines selected text or whole notes using OpenAI-compatible providers, picking prompts by the note's folder.
